Fit Slingshot pseudotime directly on a Seurat reduction

RunSlingshot.Rd

Runs slingshot directly on a Seurat dimensional reduction (PCA, Harmony, or any other integrated embedding) and a cluster identity column - no SingleCellExperiment conversion involved. Slingshot's own algorithm only ever needs a reduced-dimension matrix and cluster labels (it builds a cluster-level minimum spanning tree, then fits a principal curve per lineage), so bypassing the object conversion avoids the two biggest practical problems with Seurat-wrapper packages for trajectory inference:

  • the expression matrix is never touched, so there is no renormalize-already-normalized-data risk downstream, and

  • there is no assay/version stripping to do first - it does not matter whether the object has BPCells, sketch, or multiple v5 assays, since only the embedding matrix (always dense) and a metadata column are read.

Results are written back onto seurat_object so they can be reused without recomputation: per-cell pseudotime as meta.data columns (<prefix>_Pseudotime_1, _2, ...) and the fitted model, cluster MST, and lineage paths in seurat_object@misc$slingshot. Use SlingshotLineages afterward to see which lineage number corresponds to which cluster path.

Usage

RunSlingshot(
  seurat_object,
  cluster.by,
  reduction = NULL,
  dims = NULL,
  max_dims = 20L,
  start.clus = NULL,
  end.clus = NULL,
  approx_points = NULL,
  use_sketch = TRUE,
  downsample = NULL,
  prefix = "Slingshot",
  progress = TRUE,
  poll_interval = 10,
  caffeinate = FALSE,
  output_dir = NULL
)

Arguments

seurat_object

A Seurat object with at least one dimensional reduction computed.

cluster.by

Character. Metadata column of cluster/cell-type identities to build the lineage structure on.

reduction

Character or NULL. Reduction to fit on. NULL (default) auto-detects: prefers "harmony" or any other integration-style reduction (name matching "integrated", "scvi", "mnn", "scanorama") over a plain "pca", so batch-corrected embeddings are used by default when present.

dims

Integer vector or NULL. Which components of reduction to use. NULL (default) uses the first max_dims available - see max_dims.

max_dims

Integer. When dims is NULL, the number of leading components to use from reduction. Default 20L. Principal-curve fitting cost scales with dimensionality (roughly 6x slower going from 2 to 50 dims at matched cell count in local testing), so a Harmony/PCA reduction with 30-50 computed components is capped rather than used in full. Ignored if dims is supplied explicitly, or if reduction has fewer than max_dims components (e.g. a 2D UMAP).

start.clus

Character or NULL. Root cluster (level of cluster.by) that lineages should originate from. Strongly recommended - without it, Slingshot's MST is unrooted and lineage direction is arbitrary.

end.clus

Character vector or NULL. Optional terminal cluster(s) to constrain lineage endpoints.

approx_points

Integer or NULL. Passed to slingshot::slingshot(); reduces the number of points used to fit principal curves, which speeds up large runs at a small cost to smoothness. NULL uses Slingshot's default (no approximation).

use_sketch

Logical. If the object has a "sketch" assay (from SketchData()), fit on those cells only, as a fast preview. Default TRUE. Has no effect if no "sketch" assay exists.

downsample

Integer or NULL. If supplied (and no usable "sketch" assay was found), cap each cluster.by level at this many cells before fitting, for a fast preview on large objects. Cells not included in the fit get NA pseudotime. Default NULL (use all cells).

prefix

Character. Prefix for the pseudotime meta.data columns. Default "Slingshot".

progress

Logical. Show live "still fitting" heartbeat messages while Slingshot runs, so a long fit is never silent. Requires the callr package (runs the fit in a background process so R can poll and print while waiting); this also keeps the wait itself interruptible via Ctrl+C at any point, unlike being blocked directly inside Slingshot's own fitting code. Falls back to a plain blocking call with an upfront message only if callr is not installed. Default TRUE.

poll_interval

Numeric. Seconds between heartbeat messages when progress = TRUE. Default 10.

caffeinate

Logical. Prevent the machine from sleeping for the duration of the fit (macOS/Windows only; see RunCellChat). Default FALSE.

output_dir

Character or NULL. Directory to write analysis_params.json documenting this run. NULL (default) walks up to the output_dir stored by PrepObject (respecting AutoSavePlots); pass NA to suppress entirely.

Value

seurat_object with pseudotime columns added to meta.data and the fitted result in @misc$slingshot.
